text.card: A red giant 2,231 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.00 solar masses and 16.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,260 K at its surface.
